bratte-bratte:ashbyhq:6fb001a6-d051-454d.title: Product Designer
bratte-bratte:ashbyhq:6fb001a6-d051-454d.description: About us We're building Animates — an AI companion app where design is the product. Not a chatbot. Not a waifu app. A companion who remembers what you told them three weeks ago, notices you're off before you say so, and is still there on your laptop when you close your phone. They have a face. They look at you when you speak. They react in real time — the tilt of the head, the pause before an answer, the thing that crosses their expression when a sentence lands. We're building an actual relationship — memory, emotional intelligence, presence — across every screen a person owns. All of it rests on one thing: our own animation model, running locally on-device. This isn't a promise — it's already out in the world. Our companions shipped inside xAI's Grok app, and we demoed live on hardware at CES 2026 with Razer. The team behind it built MSQRD (100M+ users, acquired by Facebook) and Loóna (Apple Design Award), with an on-device model built by ex-Meta engineers. The role You own the entire design scope of the product. Not screens — the experience. Onboarding, character selection and profiles, the relationship progression system, gamification, re-engagement, monetisation flows, and the design system that holds it all together. Most of it is still greenfield. - How a person uses it. Day 1, day 7, day 90. The first time they meet their companion, and the thousandth. - How different people use it. A 19-year-old in Osaka and a 25-year-old in Texas won't use this the same way. Cohorts, funnels, retention — you read them and you act on them. - How the product speaks. Notifications, empty states, paywalls, the moment it says nothing at all. Every surface is the character talking. - Across every platform. Mobile first, then macOS/Windows, then web — one unified feature set. Systems thinking isn't a nice-to-have here; it's the job. How we work You'll work closely with the product team day to day — that's where most of your communication lives: shaping direction, pressure-testing ideas, deciding what ships. And you'll sit side by side with engineers to get implementation right. Voice and animation have dedicated owners; everything else in the product experience is yours to shape. You - 5+ years in product design — consumer, mobile-first, cross-platform, with a portfolio that proves it. - You've shipped products people opened every day — real audiences, real metrics, real consequences. - You make the call, and you own the outcome. You don't wait for permission to fix what's broken. - A feel for global consumer culture and where trends move — you follow what resonates across markets and audiences, and you're genuinely curious to go deeper into ours. We build for the US, Japan, and Korea, and a designer who only reads Western taste will miss half the room. Fluency in anime, gaming, or fandom aesthetics is a real plus, but the non-negotiable is the instinct to notice cultural nuance and the willingness to immerse. - You'd rather ship three rough versions than polish one in isolation. - You use AI tools daily and still think for yourself. - Working English (B1+). Plus Russian, Ukrainian, or Belarusian — that's how the team talks internally today. Don't apply if you need a PM to hand you a spec, or six weeks before you're comfortable showing a screen. What we offer - Remote across Europe, Warsaw hub — coworking covered wherever you are. - 29 days of paid leave. - Care bonus to spend on benefits that matter to you. - Any hardware you want — latest MacBook or whatever does the job. - A small team that has done this before, and a product with no precedent to copy. - Your first design in front of real users within a month of joining. Hiring process 1. Intro call with HR — who you are, what you're looking for, how we work. 2. Short call with the team — a deeper look at your experience and past work. 3. Live whiteboard session — one real problem, one hour, thinking out loud side by side. No take-home, no unpaid homework, ever. To apply Pick two screens

databricksventures-replit-com:ashbyhq:93.description: Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation. ABOUT THE ROLE This is a zero-to-one Product Engineering role on Replit's Money team. You'll bring our financial partnerships alive from scoping to integrating and operating them so that the builders on Replit, and the Apps and Agents they ship can transact reliably anywhere in the world. Money at Replit isn’t traditional payments. Builders are publishing apps that earn revenue. Agents are spending and being paid for work. New protocols for agentic commerce now exist to power the future of commerce: Shared Payment Tokens, the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP), the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP), the Machine Payments Protocol (MPP). Replit is one of the platforms that will define what they look like in practice and lower the barrier to entry. To make any of that real, we need someone who can sit between Replit engineering and our financial partners including billing platforms, payment processors, agentic-commerce protocol partners, tax and compliance vendors to turn signed contracts into live, reliable integrations. You'll be the engineer partners ask for, and the engineer the rest of Replit relies on when a new monetization surface needs to ship. This role is a fit if you like writing code and you also like being in the room when a partnership is being scoped, because you know that the design decisions made in that room are the ones that bind the integration for years. YOU WILL - Take financial partnerships from zero-to-one: scope the integration with the partner, pressure-test data and protocol specs, design the system, build it, ship it, and operate it. - Own the technical relationship with Replit's financial partners across the full lifecycle: billing platforms, payment processors, agentic-commerce protocol partners, tax/compliance vendors, KYC/risk providers. - Build and maintain Replit's integrations with agentic-commerce protocols (ACP, UCP, MPP) and Shared Payment Tokens, so Replit Agents and the apps Replit users ship can transact across AI surfaces. - Design the abstractions that let other Replit engineers monetize new products without each one having to relearn the partner stack; clear seams, versioned interfaces, and integrations that age gracefully. - Build the observability layer for partner-facing flows: webhook reliability, reconciliation, latency SLOs, partner-incident response, and the dashboards that let us see partner failures before users do. - Drive partner-side incident response when integrations degrade, including escalation paths, post-incident reviews with the partner, and the eng work to harden the integration so the same class of failure doesn't recur. - Represent Replit in technical reviews with partners: API design feedback, protocol input, joint roadmaps. Bring what you learn back into Replit's monetization architecture. - Partner closely with finance, accounting, data, legal, and BD so the integrations you build produce auditable financial data, satisfy contractual SLAs, and unlock the commercial deals behind them. REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE - 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend expertise. - Direct, hands-on experience integrating with at least one external financial-partner platform end-to-end, but owning the integration through go-live and steady-state operation. Examples include payment processors, billing/metering platforms, tax engines, KYC/risk vendors, banking-as-a-service providers, or card-issuing platforms. - Track record of taking integrations from zero-to-one: scoping with the partner, navigating ambiguous specs, and shipping a production-grade integration that you then had to operate. - Strong system-design instincts in high-correctness domains where money, idempotency, retries, reconciliat

jobgether-jobgether:lever:f49d0ad6-0e84-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Site Reliability Engineer - Imunify Reliability Platform based in Saudi Arabia. This is a greenfield SRE leadership opportunity within a large-scale, security-focused product environment. You will define what “healthy” means across roughly 70 components spanning cloud services and customer-hosted agents. You will establish SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, monitoring standards, alerting, and escalation practices from the ground up. Your work will directly improve the ability to detect silent security-control degradation before it becomes a widespread customer-impacting issue. You will collaborate closely with engineering leads and senior engineers while building the telemetry and reliability platform yourself. The environment is remote-first, async, technically demanding, and focused on measurable outcomes rather than dashboards for their own sake. This is an opportunity to shape the reliability culture and foundations of a major security product. Define and establish meaningful SLIs for approximately 70 product components, working with squad leads and senior engineers to agree on ownership, measurement, tiering, SLOs, and error budgets. Develop a reliability taxonomy covering service availability and latency, fleet reachability and configuration convergence, security-control efficacy, artifact delivery, and telemetry pipeline health. Ensure reliability indicators are independently measurable and cannot be disabled by the same failure they are intended to detect. Design and build the telemetry collection pipeline for customer-hosted agents and cloud services, balancing push-based collection, sampling, privacy constraints, data quality, and cardinality.
